name: kse-edu
description: Учебный центр КФБ — Educational CRM (курсы, студенты, преподаватели)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n edu-api,edu-web -c green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.db:down: echo "Shared Postgres: stop from kse-kg with npm run db:down"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:ensure && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
